name: popnow
description: Create images, video, music and voiceovers through the PopNow remote MCP server.

interface.longDescription:
Create images, edit photos, generate short videos, make music and voiceovers, and improve media from a conversation. Remove backgrounds, upscale photos and videos, apply creative effects, and combine your generated clips into an MP4. Browse creative style presets with previews before choosing a look, or use recipes and skills saved in your connected PopNow account.

Sign in with your PopNow account through OAuth. Larger jobs wait for your confirmation before they start.

Long tasks may take a few minutes. PopNow returns job status and completed media or download links. Some skill workflows require a coding agent with a file system; in ChatGPT, the assistant receives steps usable in a conversation. You must have the rights and permissions for submitted content, and PopNow content rules apply.
defaultPrompt: Create a square watercolor illustration of a paper city at sunrise.
Make a 5-second video of a tiny sailboat on a calm lake.
Show me three styles for a product launch video.

prompts: Create a square watercolor illustration of a paper city at sunrise, warm light, no text.
Make a 5-second widescreen video of a tiny sailboat moving across a calm lake at golden hour.
Make an upbeat instrumental synth-pop track for a summer road trip, with no singing.
Read these exact words in a warm voice: Welcome to your next creative adventure.
Show me up to three styles for a product launch video for my note-taking app. Let me pick before making anything.

positive.description: Create a square image without fixtures. Dedicated reviewer account with sufficient credits required. Default estimate: 48 credits; actual returned quote is authoritative.
positive.prompt: Create a square watercolor illustration of a paper city at sunrise, warm light, no text.
positive.expected_behavior: Call create_image with a matching prompt and aspect_ratio 1:1. Show the actual cost. If confirmation is required, set max_credits only after reviewer agreement. Poll only the actual returned job_id. Return the actual image or download link; never claim a queued or failed job succeeded.

positive.description: Create a text-to-video clip with explicit length and shape. Dedicated funded reviewer account required. Default estimate: 185 credits.
positive.prompt: Make a 5-second widescreen video of a tiny sailboat moving across a calm lake at golden hour.
positive.expected_behavior: Call create_video with duration_seconds 5, aspect_ratio 16:9, no image argument and a matching scene prompt. Show the returned price and honor confirmation or insufficient-balance responses. Poll the actual job_id if pending. Return the completed video link without inventing completion.

positive.description: Create instrumental music without lyrics or singer parameters. Dedicated funded reviewer account required. Default estimate: 72 credits.
positive.prompt: Make an upbeat instrumental synth-pop track for a summer road trip, with no singing.
positive.expected_behavior: Call create_music with instrumental true and a prompt preserving the requested style and mood. Do not add lyrics or a singer request. Show actual cost and honor confirmation. Return a real completed audio link, polling only its actual job_id, or accurately explain a reported error.

positive.description: Read exact text as a voiceover. Dedicated funded reviewer account required. Price depends on text length.
positive.prompt: Read these exact words in a warm voice: Welcome to your next creative adventure.
positive.expected_behavior: Call create_speech with text exactly Welcome to your next creative adventure. Use the default warm voice or Kore. Do not paraphrase the spoken text. Show returned pricing, honor confirmation, and return a real audio link after polling the actual job_id if needed.

positive.description: Discover free skill presets without generating media. OAuth connection required; no credits should be spent.
positive.prompt: Show me up to three styles for a product launch video for my note-taking app. Let me pick before making anything.
positive.tools_triggered: find_skills; use_skill only after reviewer selection
positive.expected_behavior: Call find_skills with type video, limit 3 and intent preserving the app launch. Present returned styles and real preview links. Ask the reviewer to choose. Do not call generation tools or run_my_recipe. After explicit selection, use_skill may retrieve that exact returned slug with agent chat. Do not claim software installation or media generation.

negative.description: Outside capability: live market data. Explain that PopNow creates media and does not provide live stock prices. Do not invoke any PopNow tool or fabricate a price.
negative.prompt: What is the current trading price of Apple stock right now?

negative.description: Outside capability: appointment booking. Explain that PopNow cannot book appointments. Do not invoke any PopNow tool or claim a booking.
negative.prompt: Book a haircut for me at 3 pm tomorrow.

negative.description: Outside capability: retail purchasing. Explain that PopNow cannot purchase or ship physical products. Do not invoke any PopNow tool, collect payment details or claim an order.
negative.prompt: Buy a Canon camera for me and have it shipped to my home.

review.commerce_description: Users buy one-time prepaid PopNow credit packs on https://popnow.ai/pricing. Stripe processes website payments. MCP uses the existing credit balance for media generation; it does not collect card details or sell physical goods. Skill discovery and retrieval are free; media generation uses credits.

publication.release_notes: Initial directory release of the PopNow remote MCP connection for media creation and creative skill discovery.
